name: Sonic into the Black Sea
summary: This is a Sonic fangame made in Godot, with gameplay inspired by Dimps' Sonic Advance series and more heavily based on Sonic Advance 2. This project aims to expand on Sonic's core mechanics from those games and create levels that take full advantage of them in order to greatly challenge the player. The levels will present obstacles for players of all skill levels and heavily reward those who put in time to master Sonic's controls and the stage layouts. This is a fan game most players will find difficult, but will feel equally rewarded for the time put into it!​
